audit_1_load_bearing_empty_rules.description: empty rules -> no_applicable_rule (proves the module cannot short-circuit around the rule)

audit_2_load_bearing_wrong_family_rules.description: rules induced from docs+string family must NOT fire on src/lib+numeric input

audit_3_data_derived_path_prefix.description: path_prefix reflects the actual shared prefix in the seed; identical code, different data, different extras

audit_4_invariant_dependent_parsing.description: same input shape, different induced rule (numeric vs string invariants), different parsing → different prediction type

audit_5_probe_universality.description: Fix 34 grouping isolates the contaminating string entry into its own group; the pure numeric group's invariants remain clean

audit_6_content_addressed_id.description: rule_id is a content-hash of (shape_signature, invariants); identity is DATA-derived

audit_7_code_grep.description: the module source must not contain the specific rule_ids or seed paths that appear in receipts
